extension.summary: Record and display playback history with resume support
记录播放历史，支持断点续播，方便继续观看电视剧
extension.description: Play History automatically records every file you play in Kodi. Browse your playback history in reverse chronological order, see how much you watched, and resume from where you left off. Perfect for continuing TV series.
播放历史插件自动记录您在 Kodi 中播放的每个文件。按逆序浏览播放历史，查看观看进度，并从中断处继续观看。特别适合追剧继续观看。
